notes.title: Restaurant Builder Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello Restauranters,

[b][h3]We have a big surprise for you! A demo update that will add not one, but two new levels! [/h3][/b]

[u]One is an Asian-style restaurant[/u] that you can arrange in your way and run to satisfy customers, and the other is a classic American garden with BBQ - no renovation or cleaning required, just cooking! You can buy these locations in the game's "Buy/Sell Property" section on the tablet [TAB].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/f15aebdc73f6080fd07dd1a03d74d826cd5e0e86.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/ff6156f97a48e4e579a6b98d2c64aa113a83ffb4.png[/img]

[b]Check out the new cool grills - carbeque rules![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/5cdd86b06c35ad25b6a848e100ee8de2917c6753.png[/img]

We've also[b] added new ingredients[/b]: two types of buns, onion, veggie cutlet, and yummy bacon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/23ec9db528f6f7e4cc4ac603579fbfed812bd463.png[/img]

What's more, you will be able to make a [b]new recipe - tortilla[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/4fa16a7cf94409777da2716483210ae8bd84c480.png[/img]

There are also fixes and improvements to some UIs and translations, as well as many more bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/d5f60fc8c62716b18447d38c9896c619b0dd8199.png[/img]

[h3][b]List of changes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] New levels available: Oriental-style restaurant for renovating and managing, and an American garden with BBQ, exclusively for cooking
[*] New items added to the shop
[*] A new recipe is now available
[*] New ingredients are now available
[*] UI improvements
[*] Translation enhancements
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]


Don't wait, check out this update!

Restaurant Builder Team

notes.title: Show me the gameplay
notes.content:
[b]We welcome all fans of building, decorating and restaurants.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/d60b966503e486948a14f615a9bed4513961d491.jpg[/img]

We have prepared the first extensive devlog for you, in which you can learn about the often unique mechanics of the game's features, and at the same time see how the game looks like in the wash (remember that this is not the final gameplay and many things can change/improve).

[b]Combining, decorating and copying[/b]

[previewyoutube=Cfg7Ty6uRI8;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ We buy an item, e.g. a chair.

➡️ We choose its color, here blue. We set the item where we want and quickly snap another one of the same.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uJXByea.gif[/img]

➡️ We add the tablecloth we choose in the store for decorative purposes. Since we're in a restaurant, it would be good to create an atmosphere. A lit candle on the table will do the job for us.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YrnWhkd.gif[/img]

➡️ After finishing, we can set the whole thing where we want and save it so that in the future we can buy the whole set with 1 click. For those who want to save even more time - there is copying several elements at once.

➡️ We have a lot of items and little space? We can always put them on top of each other

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vLfgYyb.gif[/img]

✅ A large part of the dance floor prepared for customer reception in a few moments.

[b]Physics[/b]
[previewyoutube=ZFCyq7BuQ8s;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ We have two physics modes in the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fnHPsns.gif[/img]

✅ Locked mode - useful for decorating. Nothing will fall, nothing will move.
✅ Unlocked mode - realistic simulation. We throw, smash, push, etc. etc.

➡️ Moving elements are also subject to physical simulation. What our imagination can create :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OhTO8zq.gif[/img]

[b]Illumination[/b]
[previewyoutube=WTKfygqmI5I;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ Lighting in the restaurant as well as in our game is very important. Good lighting is the key to success. We have a huge selection. Let's try to create a unique atmosphere of our restaurant.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/phAoB7a.gif[/img]

➡️ We can play electrician in the game, combine different types of lighting, e.g. to one switch.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HqSVeQ0.gif[/img]

[b]Destruction[/b]
[previewyoutube=W-zPWIIkcq0;full][/previewyoutube]

➡️ Here you don't have to explain to anyone what destruction/demolishing or smashing means. As the saying goes "you have to tear down something before you can start building process"

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8EExMCX.gif[/img]

If you are still here, you are certainly interested in the topic and every idea, opinion or comment is very important to us and will help us deliver the best possible game. It's best to go to our official channel [url=https://discord.com/invite/YBVMXVCEAN]discord[/url] and share your feedback with us and the rest of the players.

Best regards and see you next time.
